tone_stack.topology: TS808-style active: fixed RC LPF + pot splitting between op-amp + and - inputs with RC shunt on wiper
tone_stack.behaviour: a = wiper fraction from + side. Vx=V+=V-. Node X: (Vin-Vx)/R7 = sC4*Vx + (Vx-Vw)/(a*P). Node W: (Vx-Vw)/(a*P) + (Vx-Vw)/((1-a)*P) = Vw/(Rw+1/(sCw)). Output: Vout = Vx + Zf*(Vx-Vw)/((1-a)*P), Zf = Rf || 1/(sCf). a->0: wiper shunt loads + node (treble cut); a->1: shunt on - leg -> treble boost up to ~1+Rf/Rw above ~12.5 kHz, limited by Cf pole at 1.59 kHz.
